result.title: MC-PanDA++: Simpler, Stronger, and More Robust Domain-Adaptive Panoptic Segmentation
result.summary: Unsupervised domain adaptation (UDA) reduces the annotation burden in panoptic segmentation by leveraging a cost-effectively labeled source domain (e.g., synthetic) and an unlabeled target domain to bridge the distribution gap. Existing panoptic UDA methods rely on teacher-student consistency learning built upon suboptimal per-pixel segmentation architectures. In contrast, state-of-the-art mask transformers are rarely adopted due to their pronounced vulnerability to confirmation bias in consistency learning, where erroneous teacher predictions are reinforced during training. Our earlier approach, MC-PanDA, mitigates this issue through fine-grained confidence estimation, which suppresses gradients from unreliable masks while sampling informative yet reliable locations for loss computation. However, this method entails a complex multi-stage training and requires careful hyperparameter tuning. This work presents MC-PanDA++, which addresses these limitations by introducing: (i) self-supervised vision encoders that provide a stronger and more robust initialization, further reducing the reliance on human annotations, (ii) per-class, self-adapting mask-wide loss scaling that stabilizes training and enables the usage of a single set of hyperparameters across domains, and (iii) a single-stage training pipeline that decreases overall conceptual complexity. Together, these improvements result in a conceptually simpler, better-performing, and more robust method for domain-adaptive panoptics. Source code: https://github.com/martinovicivan/MC-PanDA

AI.brief_summary: 该工作面向无监督域适应的全景分割，用自监督视觉编码器初始化、按类自适应掩码损失缩放和单阶段训练流水线改进 mask transformer 的一致性学习，缓解确认偏差并简化训练。
AI.relevance_reason: 研究主题是域适应全景分割的训练稳定性与分割精度，未涉及 VLM 推理状态生成、latent 表示使用或证据筛选决策，与 LVR 主线缺少实质联系。
